# Native equipment-installation document

The whole owner resource and configurator XML belong to BUH `ПередачаОборудованияВМонтаж`, UUID `5090a026-1905-481c-a2ad-14615a34b4d4`. Existing native CF/XML extraction is the primary evidence; no database acquisition was performed for this change.

The measured profile has 10 own attributes, two tabular sections with 10 fields, and 20 qualified type rows. The local current40 header2 fallback is attempted only after the existing section lookup returns unknown and complete own membership is available. It preserves the existing known-section route.

`synthetic-section-tags3.deflate` changes only the two section header tags to exercise the old known-section route. It is a causal control, not a claimed native profile. `causal-controls.json` records these mutations. Native `owner.deflate` and `Document.xml` remain unchanged.

The external tests compare all XML UUIDs, order, types, references and qualifiers and check atomic fallback rejection. Unknown metadata is never replaced by empty metadata.
